QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] A New Leaf
QuestInfo.0: It's time to demand the whole truth from Mayor Icebyrd Slimm. Meet with him and learn what's really going on in Masteria.
QuestInfo.1: It's time to demand the whole truth from Mayor Icebyrd Slimm. Meet with him and learn what's really going on in Masteria.
